answer: Because the timing is published against the glacier challenge, the opal audit can replay the willow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 303 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 1544 identities would post 2927 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
